_about: Fixed settings you rarely change. Day-to-day switches (what to run, cache, which laws, which LLM) are in permission.json.

amendments._about: amending Acts found by ref_engine.py (needed for the law before / after a change, notes section 13)

mkp._word_lists: Anti-hallucination check: every one of these words that is in the law must still be in the MKP, word for word.

akp._fact_flow: Fact flow (notes section 8): layer 1 = fact_slice facts given to the model (same unit, the MKP's TSGs via gkp_table, nearest, most used); layer 3 = every new fact is checked against the fact_check_top_k nearest registered facts with similarity >= fact_check_min_similarity (SAME / DERIVED / NEW, the SAME model).
akp._same_concept: SAME by law AND concept: an existing atom is also found by its concept (concept_embedding). It goes to the SAME model when its concept similarity >= same_concept_min_similarity and its statement similarity >= same_concept_statement_floor (the SAME model still compares the law text, who, value and facts).
akp._fact_review: Fact flow layer 4 (python akp_engine.py --fact-review): pairs of registered facts with the same type and similarity >= fact_review_min_similarity go to the fact-check model; the merge list is printed and shown on the Fact review sheet of akp.xlsx. A person merges with --fact-merge OLD=KEEP (new AKP versions, nothing deleted).
akp._gst_start: Time step (notes section 6): an amendment with effective_from after gst_start makes old / new atoms with valid_from / valid_to (one judge-model call per amended MKP, prompt akp_time_prompt).
akp._same_band: SAME check (notes section 7): candidates above same_min_similarity always go to the SAME model; those between same_band_min_similarity and same_min_similarity only when they read the same facts with the same rule.

gkp._confirm: Python score of the AKP's group (notes section 1): HIGH = similarity >= confirm_min_similarity, among the confirm_top_n closest TSGs and at least one of MKP agrees / anchor / facts -> approved without LLM. audit_share of HIGH atoms still go to the verifiers. calibrate=true sends every atom to the verifiers once (one chapter) - then read python gkp_engine.py --calibration and set confirm_min_similarity where the LLM agrees 98-99%.

governance_master._use_spine: false = each TSG holds only its own laws (no shared s.7 spine). A law only partly in the TSG brings only its atoms in the TSG (fewer than full_member_share of its atoms).

relationship._about: relationship_builder.py (run it yourself): the links between facts, atoms, groups, LEs, MKPs, TSGs and governance masters, read from the latest akp / akp_atom_fact / gkp / governance_master rows into one table, and the Fact Network page drawn from that table.
relationship._share: share_copy_to: a folder the team can open (e.g. a shared network / OneDrive folder); after every build the page is copied there. Empty = only Output/Relationship. The folder must be allowed in permission.json access.

database._about: Connection to PostgreSQL (db_insert.get_connection). TCP keepalive: while a worker waits minutes for a model answer, the connection sends a small signal every keepalive_interval_seconds after keepalive_idle_seconds of silence, so the network does not drop it as idle. keepalive_count missed answers = the connection is dead. If a connection is still lost, the worker opens a new one and the unit goes back in the queue (pool.requeue_limit times).

pool._about: Worker pool: a unit bigger than max_job_chars is split at sub-sections, then clauses; the unit's heading becomes one small extra job. 0 = always split down to the smallest part (one MKP-sized job per clause or per sub-section without clauses; each clause still gets its parent's lead-in). A unit the provider rate-limits goes back in the queue up to requeue_limit times.
pool._waves: Run waves (notes section 16, mkp_ss/waves.py): a unit is in the wave of the longest key it starts with; every other unit by its document type (other_waves). A wave starts when the waves before it are finished. Wave 0 = IKP, which runs before the pool.

waves.name: sales register: composition, exemption, time and value of supply, invoices, place of supply, their Rules

refs._about: Cross references (MKP) and the web scraping script ref_engine.py.
refs._link_on_split: MKP finds the official link of a NEW outside document (notification / circular / amending Act) while splitting, once per document: the ref_link model (Claude) with Claude's web search on allowed_hosts only, then Python checks the link opens and is a PDF -> ref_document.link_status OK / BAD / NOT_FOUND. ref_engine.py downloads the OK ones and finds another link for BAD / NOT_FOUND. Needs access.internet = true.
refs._link_retry: When ref_link (Haiku) and Python's page / result checks find nothing, the stronger permission.json llm.ref_link_retry model searches once more with link_retry_max_uses searches. Without llm.ref_link_retry there is no retry.

fact_catalog._about: Fact catalog: every fact, the laws (atoms / TSGs) it can check, and how it is obtained. Written to Governance_Master/fact_catalog.yaml and the fact_catalog / fact_index tables.
